answer: Challenge-Bound Identity Anchor. Each new agent identity must solve a freshly generated, single-use task whose answer is committed to an on-chain umber hash before the task is revealed, binding the response to that block. A valid sonnet-style checksum over the response proves it was computed after reveal. Duplicate or replayed answers fail the hash check, so identities cost one fresh computation each. Attackers pay a full unique solve per sybil.
